description: M7 recommendation relevance. Ten Spanish customer queries over the commerce-domain@0.3.0 catalog with graded relevance (0-3) per SKU for nDCG@3; empty grades mean no SKU is eligible and the answer must report no candidates. Grades written by hand by a single author; not adjudicated by a second reviewer. Eligibility itself is checked independently in SQL by the suite, not from these grades.
